mission_01.speaker: MAYA
mission_01.text: Vice District. Pretty lights, ugly secrets. You must be Alex.

mission_01.speaker: ALEX
mission_01.text: I'm looking for my brother. Leo disappeared three weeks ago.

mission_01.speaker: MAYA
mission_01.text: Then you need to understand this city. Nobody vanishes without someone noticing.

mission_01.speaker: ALEX
mission_01.text: You said you had a lead.

mission_01.speaker: MAYA
mission_01.text: I do. But first, prove I can trust you. Take this case to Nico.

mission_02.speaker: NICO
mission_02.text: Maya sent you? Put the case there. Carefully. I like my workbench without surprises.

mission_02.speaker: NICO
mission_02.text: Yeah. Three days before he vanished. He kept checking the mirrors like someone was following him.

mission_02.speaker: ALEX
mission_02.text: Did he say where he was going?

mission_02.speaker: NICO
mission_02.text: No. But he asked me to remove a tracker. I told him that was a terrible idea.

mission_03.speaker: NICO
mission_03.text: I kept the old repair notes. Didn't think they'd matter.

mission_03.speaker: NICO
mission_03.text: Not active. Sleeping. It woke up twice near the industrial belt.

mission_03.speaker: NICO
mission_03.text: Take a jacket. Industrial belt eats phones and people.

mission_04.speaker: VESPER
mission_04.text: You want information. Everyone wants information. The trick is knowing what it's worth.

mission_04.speaker: ALEX
mission_04.text: I'm looking for a signal tied to a port shipment.

mission_04.speaker: VESPER
mission_04.text: That's either very boring or very dangerous. Usually both.

mission_04.speaker: VESPER
mission_04.text: Maybe. First tell me: are you paying, trading, or asking a favour?

mission_05.speaker: MAYA
mission_05.text: But it does. Can you hear that?

mission_05.speaker: ALEX
mission_05.text: Three short pulses. Then a pause.

mission_05.speaker: MAYA
mission_05.text: Leo used to tap that rhythm when he was thinking.

mission_05.speaker: ALEX
mission_05.text: So this is meant for me.
